target_customer: Image and health conscious consumers, shown by tech worker testimonials, who pay for measurement and treatment visits
problem: People cannot easily measure and track skin, hair and body metrics in one place, so appearance improvement is guesswork.
business_model: Consumer clinic visits and recurring quarterly assessments plus prescribed treatments
product_category: Consumer health and aesthetics measurement studio

founders.name: Shivani Patel
prior_employers: SpaceX Starlink (first software engineer on customer support team)
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page, built AI support tooling and took automation from 0 to 70 percent.

competitors.name: Prenuvo
competitors.traction_then: More than 170,000 scans reported by one source

competitors.name: Function Health and Ezra
competitors.what: Lab testing membership that acquired Ezra and launched a $499 full-body MRI

technical_complexity.rationale: Offered through clinical instruments, a dashboard and a medical team; operations and licensing matter more than software difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Clinical partnerships and licensed providers add friction, but the service is replicable and larger scan companies exist.

market_need_then: Consumer demand for preventive scans and longevity services grew in 2025, evidenced by Function Health buying Ezra and Prenuvo raising $120M. No skin or hair measurement demand data found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and direct, e.g. Reports you can understand

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with many companies and no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Layers is a Fall 2025 company whose YC page also shows a launch post for Telemetron, a hardware support platform, so its direction is unclear; the website describes a San Francisco studio for body measurement and treatments. No exit or shutdown was found and no round was verified. It sits in a market where Function Health and Prenuvo are well funded.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom (aggregator) lists a $125K seed; not recorded as a round. YC page lists co-founder Hamza (no last name) who previously worked on Starlink software at SpaceX; not added as a founder entry. The YC page launch post is for Telemetron, relationship to Layers unclear. YC page lists founded 2026 in one source. No outcome news found. Round update: the $125K seed is recorded; it rests on a single database (Dealroom) with no date or investors, and a cross-check search found no other source (results for other companies named Layer or Layers were ignored).
